birch.name: Birch
birch.lore: The Birch is the Pioneer, the first tree to grow in burnt landscapes. It represents renewal, adaptability, and the courage to start anew.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.lore: The Rowan is the Tree of Life in many traditions. It is believed to protect against enchantment and evil spirits.

ash.name: Ash
ash.lore: The Ash connects the three worlds: Underworld, Earth, and Sky. It is the World Tree (Yggdrasil) in Norse mythology.

oak.name: Oak
oak.lore: King of the Forest. The Oak holds the power of thunder and lightning. It represents endurance, triumph, and the doorway to mysteries.
